metadata.name: secrets-management
metadata.description: Secrets management integration family. Backend-agnostic — providers (aws-secrets-manager, gcp-secret-manager, vault, ...) implement the same operations against different storage systems. Generation strategies (random_string, template, manual, external_ref) are evaluated by the family-shared generator package.

spec.description: Generic contract for any provider that creates, rotates, reads, and deletes secrets. Generation strategies travel inline (random_string with charset, templates with nested placeholders, external_ref for cross-secret composition). The family enforces idempotency on upsert; rotation always produces a new version.

operations.name: upsert_secret
operations.description: Create the secret if absent then store a fresh value. Idempotent.

operations.name: rotate_secret
operations.description: Generate a new value and write it as a new version. Previous versions backend-managed.

operations.name: read_secret
operations.description: Return the secret value at a version. SENSITIVE — Yggdrasil should mark this output redacted.

operations.name: delete_secret
operations.description: Schedule (or force) deletion. Backends may support a recovery window.
